title: Erase part of a drawing and undo the erase
goal: On a known 4×4 blue square in a transparent 16×16 drawing, one Eraser click removes exactly one pixel; Undo restores the exact square and Redo removes exactly that pixel again.
cliOnly: a dragged four-pixel stroke and native RGBA of the neighbouring cells

steps.why: The replay draws a 4×4 blue square around the centre.
Exactly the centre pixel (8,8) is erased; the other fifteen stay blue.
Redo erases exactly the same pixel again.
